_comment: Server-side content checks (src/lib/safety/content.ts). Each entry is matched on the normalised text (lowercase, accents and look-alike characters folded, punctuation as spaces), as whole words. severity 'hard' rejects the text (400 CONTENT_REJECTED); 'soft' lets it through and files an automatic report for a moderator. This file is a starting set of scam and spam phrases: Trust & Safety owns the production list and changes it by deploy. Keep slurs and similar terms in the production list only.
